notes.subject: ol
notes.rationale: Hebrew omits the subject 'they'; Tok Pisin requires ⟨ol⟩

notes.subject: kilim
notes.rationale: ירצחו is the verb of murder (רצח), distinct from plain killing; Tok Pisin uses one verb with context marking the crime

translation: Ol i kilim ⟨את⟩ ol wida na ⟨את⟩ ol man bilong narapela ples, na ol i kilim ⟨את⟩ ol pikinini bilong ol papa i dai pinis.
